name: Phayeng
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Huziwara, Keisuke 2019. Paiengo no gengo tokucho [Linguistic features of Phayeng] (12pp, in Japanese; Glottolog MED phonology_or_text); not found in CiNii or online.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page phay1241 and reference records 587676, 587674 (glottolog.org)
sources.note: Classification Sino-Tibetan > Brahmaputran > Jingpho-Luish > Luish > Chakpa-Kadu-Ganan > Chakpa > Phayeng; AES extinct (source Huziwara 2019); no grammar or sketch references.

sources.citation: Huziwara, Keisuke. 2020 [online 2021-06]. On the genetic position of Chakpa within Luish languages. Himalayan Linguistics 19(2) (Languages and Peoples of the Eastern Himalayan Region): 44-55. doi:10.5070/H91150999
sources.note: Nothing on stress/accent. Sec. 2.2 'Phonology' covers vowels, addition of final stops, tones; sec. 2.2.4 p.49: 'Generally speaking, tones of Chakpa are unknown as they are no longer spoken nor recorded. Ch. Y. Singh (2014) shows two distinctive tones (mid and high) for Chakpa [Andro].' Phayeng named only as one of the Chakpa villages; footnote 2 says Kh. Ch. Devi 2018 on Phayeng describes a Meitei variety.

sources.citation: KAKEN research reports, JSPS KAKENHI 16K02691 (藤原敬介, FY2016-2019), FY2017 実施状況報告書 and FY2019 実績報告書, kaken.nii.ac.jp
sources.note: Nothing on stress; establishes identity: Feb 2018 fieldwork in Manipur on 'the Phayeng dialect of Chakpa, a dead language' plus Andro materials; Dec 2019 talk on Phayeng linguistic features.

sources.citation: Devi, Kh. Chaobi. 2018. Vowels in the phonology of Phayeng dialects. ZENITH International Journal of Multidisciplinary Research 8(7): 49-58.
sources.note: Online PDF contains only abstract and reference list (4 pp), no body; nothing on stress. Describes the MEITEI (Manipuri) dialect of the Phayeng Loi community ('one of the dialects of Manipuri like Sekmai, Andro, Khurkhul'), i.e. not the Luish Chakpa language phay1241.

sources.citation: 藤原敬介 [Huziwara Keisuke]. 2014. ルイ祖語の再考 [Proto-Luish reconsidered]. 京都大学言語学研究 (Kyoto University Linguistic Research) 33: 1-32. hdl:2433/196280
sources.note: Comparative reconstruction; Chakpa represented only by Andro and Sengmai from McCulloch 1859, with the note that their tones were not recorded (声調は記録されていない); Phayeng not mentioned; nothing on stress. (PDF text layer font-garbled; read via layout + legible fragments.)

sources.citation: 藤原敬介 [Huziwara Keisuke]. 2019. パイェン語の言語特徴 [Linguistic features of Phayeng]. Handout (23 pp.), 日本歴史言語学会第9回大会, 広島大学, 2019-12-15. (Glottolog ref 587676, MED for phay1241, typed phonology;comparative)
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: The only Phayeng-specific phonological description in existence, based on Huziwara's Feb 2018 fieldwork on Chakpa-Phayeng; if any statement on Phayeng accent/stress (or its unrecoverability) exists, it is here. Obtainable only from the author (University of Hyogo; researchmap.jp/kej) or from Glottolog/hh's private file.

sources.citation: Singh, Chungkham Yashawanta. 2014. A linguistic study of dead language — Chakpa. Paper presented at SEALS 24, University of Yangon.

sources.note: Only source reporting prosodic (tone) data for Chakpa from fieldwork with Chakpa pandits (Andro variety); might comment on stress/prominence; Chakpa-level, not Phayeng-specific.
